aluminum-doping has a similar effect on the charge density of the valence-band edge in both 4H and in 6H polytype silicon carbide, while nitrogen-doping has a very different effect on the charge densities of the conduction-band edge in these two polytypes.

the valence and conduction band edge densities are very similar at all carbon sites and very different at all silicon sites in 4H- or 6H-p type samples of silicon carbide, whereas in n-type samples, the conduction band density is very similar at all sites, but the valence band density is very different at all sites.
